- I grew up in the Bay Area, California. I went to UC Davis for my bachelors where I studied both Civil and Environmental Engineering.

- I study resource recovery. Specifically I look into nutrient cycling, either nitrogen or phosphorus in wastewater or lakes. My current work is quantifying internal loading of phosphorus for Oneida Lake in New York.

- I love swimming and most water sports. During the summer I try to go to beaches or lakes as much as possible. My favorite lake to swim in is Lake Bled in Slovenia.

- I actually have no personal interest in Meerkat's, I made my lab group vote an animal to make the theme of this website.

- I strongly believe the Aflac Duck looks like a goose.
